scope: Workflow module fusion for ahra-v0.1-starter as the outer Harness template and harness-first-starter as the source of concrete workflow implementations.

resolution: Added EvidenceStore and WorkspaceProvider to src/ahra/ports.py.
TaskHarness and LoopEngine now accept workspace_ref plus provider-backed workspace/runtime dependencies.
ReferenceRunStore protocol separates module code from the concrete FileRunStore adapter.
Local Git and subprocess behavior is contained in local WorkspaceProvider and RuntimeProvider adapters.
Artifacts and Evidence receive stable IDs, local URIs, SHA-256 hashes, media types, creator metadata, and manifest records.
Workflow module examples no longer list raw events.jsonl as Evidence.
workflow-module.schema.json enumerates valid AHRA Run statuses, AWKP Task statuses, and known AHRA ports.
WorkflowModuleContract.validate performs semantic checks for required ArtifactStore, EvidenceStore, and EventPublisher boundaries.
Tests include negative probes for DefinitelyMissingPort and not_a_run_status.
Created TASK-0002 for workflow module fusion instead of reusing the old bootstrap linter task.
State is review, not completed, so independent verifier approval remains required.
Added task events, artifact manifest, evidence manifest, and handoff.

residual_risk: TASK-0002 remains in review until an independent verifier reruns checks and updates AWKP state.
FileRunStore is a local reference adapter and is not the authoritative AHRA RunStore.
